_comment: Default scoped ignores for tools/check_deck.py — copy this file beside your deck (or its parent dir) and extend it there. Shape copied VERBATIM from the house impeccable config (assay-toolkit brand/impeccable/config.seed.json): entries nest under a top-level `detector` key, and every ignoreValues entry carries a written `reason`. An entry without a reason is discarded by the linter — an ignore without a reason is a bug being hidden, not a decision.

ignoreValues.reason: Brand guide §2.1 pins True Black as the page canvas for external surfaces. Universal dark-theme craft advice prefers #0f0f0f; the house pin wins and is deliberate, not AI convergence.
Brand guide §2.4 pins #FFFFFF as Text Primary on dark surfaces. Same reasoning as C-PURE-BLACK; softening it would break the pinned contrast pair.
